items.title: Leonard Bocage Interview, 1972-03-24
items.q: All them fellas used to be by my house every day when they was at the... when they was down in the Navy band.

ctx.x: Frank plays in your band. Well, Frank Fields was, uh... Get-off player when he went in the Navy, but after he got in there, he started playing bass tuba. See, and that from bass tuba, then he got on the string bass. All them fellas used to be by my house every day when they was at the... when they was down in the Navy band. Every time they'd get off in the evening, they all would come by my house.
